authority.basis: User approved a separate bounded generated-only numerical stability study after explicit permission request.

formulations.N1_SYM_CHOLESKY: B=LLt; Hraw=solve(L,S)solve(Lt); H=sym(Hraw); P=top-only differentiable projector(H); K=L^-t P L^-1; F=K/tr(CK). Preserve rawH skew; validate original pair residual. Existing top-only derivative is already lower-multiplicity safe.
formulations.N2_GVD_IMPLICIT: CPU scipy.linalg.eigh(S,B,type=1,lower=True,driver=gvd) with B-orthonormal Z. K=zzT. VJP t=Zrest[(ZrestT(G+GT)z)/(lambda-lambda_rest)]; gradS=sym(tzT); gradB=-lambda*gradS-(zTGz)*zzT. F=K/tr(CK) outside custom function supplies C gradient. First derivatives only.

input_policy.shape: identical float64 CPU [...,8,8] S,B,C without broadcasting
input_policy.symmetry_scale: max(Frobenius norm, float64 tiny); reject nonfinite arithmetic then symmetrize accepted inputs

new_fixtures.recipe: For each seed draw Uraw,Vraw,Wraw,Esraw,Ebraw,Ecraw sequentially, each normal(8,8), ONCE. Canonical QR U/V: multiply each Q column by sign(diag(R)), replacing zero sign by +1. W,Es,Eb,Ec=sym(raw)/Fro(sym(raw)). Reuse those six matrices for the whole seed grid. Lexicographic loop condition,scale,spectrum,gap,denominator. C=scale*sym(U diag(condition**(-arange(8)/7)) Ut), except condition1 uses exact scale*I. r=8*softmax(linspace(-log(2)/2,log(2)/2,8)). B=C or sym(C+(.1*lambda_min(C)/(16/9))*diag(r)). LB/LC=numpy.linalg.cholesky. Distinct roots [-2,-1.5,-1,-.5,0,.5,1-gap,1]; repeated roots [-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,1-gap,1]. S=sym(LB V diag(roots) Vt LBt). G=sym(LC W LCt) frozen at base C. dS=sym(LB Es LBt); dB=sym(LB Eb LBt); dC=sym(LC Ec LCt). Directions S-only/B-only/C-only/joint are dimensionless perturbation coefficients applied to these stored arrays.

known_generated_regression.allowed_members: Only k{k}_cond{condition}_c and k{k}_cond{condition}_{arm}_s for k3/5,condition1/1000/100000/120000,arm UNIFORM_C2/FIXED_BOUNDED_PAIR_LOGITS. Validate entire descriptor hash before decode; no human files or other NPZ members.
known_generated_regression.case_order: Original16 rows, band0..4, class0..11. S=sym(saved s), B=C=sym(saved c). All960 matrices; known-not-unseen.
known_generated_regression.gradient_indices: band0/class0 for every old row plus row14/band0/class11 (flat index851), total17; seed20260912 draws Wraw,Esraw,Ebraw,Ecraw in that order once, sym/Fro normalize as new recipe; directions/probe use base Cholesky factors.

negative_controls.recipe: Base S=diag([-2,-1.5,-1,-.5,0,.5,.75,1]), B=C=I. Independent cases: asymmetric S, B, C each [0,1]+=.001; nonfinite S[0,0]=NaN; singular B[0,0]=0; indefinite B[0,0]=-1; singular C[0,0]=0; top tie S[-2,-2]=1; near tie S[-2,-2]=1-5e-12. Nine cases must reject, without jitter or fallback.

detached zero gradient against nonzero reference

independent_reference.backend: mpmath1.3.0 80decimal digits, spectral B^-1/2 from eigsy(B), eigsy(sym(B^-1/2 S B^-1/2)), recover top vector then C-normalize
independent_reference.input_values: exact binary64 floats converted to mpf via integer ratio, not decimal truncation or intended generator eigensystem
independent_reference.gradient_reference: For each frozen G and S/B/C/joint direction, symmetric highprecision differences h=1e-20 and1e-25. Do not round perturbed matrices to float64. Base G remains fixed under C perturbation.
independent_reference.precision_recheck: 120digits on known index851 and first/last new case of each seed; normalized reference eigenvalue/F difference<=1e-50
independent_reference.independence: Auditor imports neither producer nor cfeg operator. Reconstruct exact fixture recipe, solve actual stored floats, validate complete inventory/pins/status and each case.

audit_thresholds.residual_definition: norm(SF-lambda*BF,Fro)/((norm(S,Fro)+abs(lambda)*norm(B,Fro))*norm(F,Fro)); engineering normwise residual, not certified minimal structured backward error
audit_thresholds.projector_definition: norm(LCt*(F-Fref)*LC,Fro) with reference C factor; no absolute raw F allclose floor
audit_thresholds.coverage: Each seed and denominator family must have at least one absolute nonzero S and B reference directional gradient>1e-4; constant probe or detached gradients cannot yield an unqualified pass.

stops.method_eligible: All forward/gradient/reference/negative/oracle-sensitivity/pin/coverage checks pass across complete fixed grid and independent audit. If both eligible choose N1 prospectively for torch-native implementation; N2 is CPU-only comparator, not CUDA-ready.
stops.method_failure: Preserve all results; any required failure rejects this method for this fixed study. Do not weaken thresholds, remove cases or switch per-case methods.
stops.reference_or_integrity_failure: Study inconclusive, preserve failure; no method promotion from unverified references.
stops.after_numerical_success: Report numerical evidence and next generated learner-integration/human-program prerequisites. No automatic human run or old candidate reopening. Full metadata efficacy goal remains incomplete.
stops.after_budget_or_two_methods: Stop and report all failures/coverage/limits and next decision; no third numerical policy.
